answer: Loop-discounted attests: each epoch the ledger finds cycles of up to 4 IDs among attest edges and zeroes them, so clones vouching in a ring add nothing, like a raven praising its own nest. Other edges count 1/(1+r), r being how often that pair swapped attests over 30 epochs. A reward needs a ledge of 3 outside attests per ID; if each honest ID can cast 5 per epoch, 1,000 fakes need 3,000, or 600 honest IDs fooled every hour, while the farm sits on its own mesa with no ramp in. Proposed numbers, not measured.
